title: Una región transformada
goal: Read about Hugo Chávez's December 1998 election in Venezuela and the 1999 Constituent Assembly, as a signal that the region's political story was entering a new chapter.

items: Explain what happened in Venezuela in December 1998.
Describe how Chávez presented himself in the 1998 campaign.
State what Chávez did after taking office in February 1999.
Explain what some analysts suggested about Chávez's victory.
Use a partir de to mark a starting point in time.
